stay.id: Itu polisi. Kalau gue nggak angkat, dia punya satu alasan lagi buat nggak percaya gue.
stay.en: That's the police. If I don't answer, he has one more reason not to believe me.

text.id: Mas Raka. Ipda Yusuf. Ada waktu sebentar?
text.en: Mr. Raka. Inspector Yusuf. Do you have a moment?

text.id: Rekaman CCTV di TPI sudah saya dapat. Senin, pukul dua puluh satu lima puluh dua. Mbak Sekar turun dari mobil, dekat pintu timur.
text.en: I've got the CCTV footage from the fish auction. Monday, nine fifty-two in the evening. Ms. Sekar gets out of a car, near the east entrance.

text.id: Mobil hatchback, warna perak. Pelatnya tidak terbaca. Pengemudinya tidak turun, dan mobilnya pergi dua menit kemudian.
text.en: A hatchback, silver. The plate can't be read. The driver didn't get out, and the car left two minutes later.

text.id: Ini belum mengubah status kasusnya. Tapi untuk pertama kalinya saya punya sesuatu untuk ditulis selain "keluarga cemas".
text.en: This doesn't change the status of the case yet. But for the first time I have something to write down other than "family is anxious".

text.id: Saya kirim fotonya ke Anda. Jangan disebar.
text.en: I'll send you the still. Don't share it.

text.id: Satu lagi. Kemarin ada yang datang ke kantor. Pacarnya Mbak Sekar. Katanya ada HP cadangan, dan Anda yang pegang.
text.en: One more thing. Someone came to the station yesterday. Ms. Sekar's boyfriend. He said there's a spare phone, and that you have it.

text.id: Anda bilang ke saya tidak ada apa-apa, Mas. Saya ingat itu.
text.en: You told me there was nothing. I remember that.

text.id: Saya tidak punya dasar untuk minta rekaman apa pun. Statusnya tetap. Pergi atas kemauan sendiri.
text.en: I have no grounds to request any footage. The status stays. Left of her own accord.

text.id: Saya cuma mau mengabari. Tanpa bukti baru, kasus Mbak Sekar tetap orang dewasa yang pergi atas kemauan sendiri. Maaf, Mas.
text.en: I just wanted to let you know. Without new evidence, Ms. Sekar's case stays an adult who left of her own accord. I'm sorry.

text.id: Kapal Pak Hendra. Kalau polisi yang nanya, lain ceritanya.
text.en: Pak Hendra's boat. The police could question him in ways I can't.

text.id: "Pak, ada kapal namanya Sri Rejeki. Nomor 1427."
text.en: "Sir, there's a boat called the Sri Rejeki. Number 1427."
(Keep the boat to yourself for now.)

text.id: Sri Rejeki. Satu, empat, dua, tujuh. Saya catat. Jangan ke sana lagi sendirian, Mas.
text.en: Sri Rejeki. One, four, two, seven. Noted. Don't go back there alone.

text.id: Dan kalau ada yang menghubungi Anda soal HP itu, siapa pun, kabari saya dulu. Sebelum Anda melakukan apa-apa.
text.en: And if anyone contacts you about that phone, anyone at all, tell me first. Before you do anything.
